fold_policy.frozen_precedence_analysis: D006_FOLD_COUNT_IS_FIVE already ruled, under RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1 precedence (implementation governs over ambiguous prose) and GRAPH_POLICY s1 (frozen bytes govern), that the operative inference folds are the FIVE expanding folds train_lt_2022 .. train_lt_2026 over 2,982 rows / 1,491 clusters. Those five fold ids are exactly what the guard's EXPANDING_PRIOR_SEASONS policy emits — the D006 operative fold masks therefore FORCE the EXPANDING_PRIOR_SEASONS reading of fold_policy: naming SEASON_BLOCK would make P27 certify estimability over six per-season blocks that are not the folds anything fits or scores, an audit of masks with no operative existence. D006 also already disposed of fact (i)'s pull in the other direction: 'S7's packet measurement is tabulated by SEASON across six seasons, not by fold across six folds ... must be restated in fold terms' — i.e. the SEASON_BLOCK shape of the S7 statement is the historical basis of the support-floor rule, not an operative mask.
